headline: A 1994 executive order changed Civil Service Rule VI, part of the rules for federal government jobs.
what_it_does: This order amended Civil Service Rule VI, one of the rules that govern hiring and jobs in the federal civil service. Rule VI generally deals with jobs that are exempt from the usual competitive hiring process. The title alone does not say exactly what was changed.

who_it_affects.group: Federal government employees and job applicants
who_it_affects.how: The change may affect how certain federal jobs are handled under civil service hiring rules, but the specific details are not stated in the title.
